name: Cheesy Chicken & Mushroom Alfredo Pita Pizza

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
1 (8 oz) pkg sliced white mushrooms
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange pita breads on a large baking sheet pan. Spread Alfredo sauce over each pita, then top with chicken, mozzarella, and sautéed mushrooms. Place in the oven and bake until pitas are slightly crisp and cheese is melted, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (16 oz) jar Alfredo sauce
3 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: To serve, cut pizzas into wedges, divide between plates, and enjoy!
